messages:
maria: FYI — Acme asked us to onboard a community model called 'newton-7b' into Private. They want a 4-bit quantized build for cost reasons. Intended workloads: chat (multi-turn), structured extraction, 512 token context. Expected steady qps ~8, burst 20. Model repo: https://github.com/open/newton-7b. Can we triage and run the bring-up checklist?

kevin: @maria thanks. First checks: license (is it compatible with Private deployments?), tokenizer parity, and any custom ops. I'll add to intake tracker. Priority? medium-high?

maria: They flagged timeline ~2 weeks for POC. Mark as P1 for onboarding prioritization unless we see blockers. License looks MIT-ish but with model weights note — I added a snapshot of the LICENSE to the tracker.

sasha: Quick checklist I'm thinking:
- tokenization/parity w/ our tokenizer layer
- end-to-end float32 correctness on small prompts
- quant 4-bit recipe (PTQ or LLM.int8-like) and accuracy deltas on eval set
- perf baseline on A100 and L4 (latency & throughput)
- regression evals (qa / summarization / safety suite)
- model size & KV cache behavior (512 ctx)
- any custom kernels / cuda ops
- packaging + provenance (weights SHA)
Would also like a short prompt set from the customer (5-10 examples).

jia: I'll pick up the perf runs. Proposed experiment plan:
1) run float32 baseline single-stream (A100) using our harness (1k prompts)
2) run 4-bit PTQ using our default recipe, measure delta on eval metrics + throughput
3) try grouped-quant kernels on L4 if available
Latency SLO suggestion: p95 < 350ms for 512ctx on L4 for single-stream? Is that realistic?

kevin: p95 < 350ms is aggressive for 512 on L4 at 7B with 4-bit, but we can try with batching disabled. Put p95 < 500ms as a target for initial POC.

maria: customer is ok with 500ms p95 for now. They care more about cost/correctness than shaving ms.

eval-bot: automated-run: started eval suite run id eval-181500-1. Running: tokenization checks, LM perplexity (small wiki), qa benchmark (SQuAD subset), extraction tests. Will post results here when done.

sasha: For quant recipe, prefer PTQ with per-channel symmetric quant on weights + 8-bit bias fallback. We'll capture accuracy drift vs float32. Add a prompt-level consistency check: exact-match on extraction fields >= 95%?

maria: @sasha noted. I'll ask Acme for their extraction labels. Also need a compliance check: will we be allowed to store a copy of the weights in their VPC? Legal asked about retention policy.

oncall-ml: I'll reserve a slot on the private cluster for a 4-hour bring-up window tomorrow 09:00-13:00 PST — Node: private-gpu-12 (A100). If we need L4, ping ops to spin up a test L4 note.

jia: thanks @oncall-ml. I'll run float32 baseline on the reserved slot and then the 4-bit experiments. Quick command I'll use:
```bash
redwood-eval run --model ./newton-7b --mode float32 --ctx 512 --prompts prompts/pooled_1k.json --out results/float32.json
redwood-quant apply --model ./newton-7b --bits 4 --recipe ptq-perchannel --out ./newton-7b-4bit
redwood-eval run --model ./newton-7b-4bit --mode quant --ctx 512 --prompts prompts/pooled_1k.json --out results/4bit.json
```

eval-bot: automated-run-complete: eval-181500-1 summary:
- tokenization: OK (no mismatch)
- perplexity (wiki-small): float32 12.8, 4-bit est 13.5
- SQuAD subset F1: float32 88.1 -> 4-bit 86.2
- extraction exact-match: float32 96.2% -> 4-bit 94.5%
- top-line throughput (A100, single-stream): float32 6.5 qps, 4-bit 9.8 qps
Attach: results/ (links in tracker).

kevin: numbers look reasonable. Accuracy drop within expected range. Throughput uplift for 4-bit is good. Next: kernel coverage — any falls back to slower paths?

jia: I saw a small fallback to float kernels for rotary embeddings at long context > 1024, but for 512 ctx it's clean. I'll capture kernel logs.

sasha: Safety scan? Any red flags on toxic generations? Run our safety eval set and regression detector.

eval-bot: safety-report: toxicity metrics within baseline band; no new high-severity patterns detected on our test suite. Detailed report uploaded.

maria: Next actions:
- @kevin add license + provenance finalization
- @sasha prepare quantization recipe doc + expected QA deltas (one-pager)
- @jia and @oncall-ml finalize perf runs and kernel logs, schedule L4 test if needed
- I'll collect customer prompts & retention policy answers from legal
Timeline: aim to have POC artifacts and one-pager by EOD +3 business days.

kevin: sounds good. I'll also create canary rollout plan for Dedicated -> Private conversion, include automatic fallback to float32 variant if regressions exceed threshold.

maria: :thumbsup: Thanks all. If anyone hits a blocker ping here and escalate to eng-ml lead.

sasha: I'll start drafting the quant one-pager now and post when ready.

jia: starting baseline run now (slot confirmed). Will update with links when complete.
